user.title: Configure instance
user.description: Enter the PenguinPVDash server and assign your Home Assistant energy sensors. The server address may be entered with or without `/api/ingest.php`.

data_description.instance_name: A descriptive name such as Family, Public or Test.
data_description.server_url: Examples: `10.10.4.122:8092`, `https://pv.example.org` or a complete `/api/ingest.php` URL. The ingest path is added automatically.
data_description.api_key: Must match the API key configured for this device ID on the server.
data_description.device_id: Identifies this data source on the server, for example `home` or `home2`.
data_description.interval: How often Home Assistant sends data. One minute is recommended.
data_description.output_unit: Unit used by the configured live power sensors.
data_description.verify_server: Checks reachability, device ID and API key without writing a measurement. Disable only when configuring an offline server.

power.name: PV, consumption & grid
power.description: Live power sensors for the energy-flow dashboard.

data_description.consumption_entity: Use the final whole-house consumption sensor. For systems with an additional balcony PV system, select your calculated gross consumption sensor here.

battery.name: Battery storage
battery.description: Optional battery state and live charging power.

energy.name: Daily energy totals
energy.description: Daily kWh sensors used for history and statistics.

data_description.consumption_total_kwh_entity: Use the final whole-house daily consumption sensor. PenguinPVDash does not recalculate consumption on the server.

error.invalid_url: The server address is invalid. Use an IP address or an HTTP/HTTPS URL.
error.cannot_connect: The server could not be reached. Check address, port, firewall and Docker container.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the device ID or API key.
error.invalid_server: The address does not appear to be a compatible PenguinPVDash server.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while validating the server.

init.title: Manage instance
init.description: Edit the instance or test the currently saved server connection.

menu_option_descriptions.configure: Change server, API key, device ID, interval and sensor assignments.
